name: Goodstack Nonprofit Discounts
description: Free sign-up for discounted software like Zoom, Docusign, Adobe Acrobat, Asana, and OpenAI plans for eligible nonprofit organizations
fullDescription: Goodstack (formerly Percent) is a free platform that verifies nonprofits and helps them access discounted software from major companies like Zoom, Docusign, Adobe, Asana, and OpenAI.
whatTheyOffer:
- Up to 50% off select Zoom products
- 30-50% off select Docusign products
- 50% off Asana Starter and Advanced plans
- Discounts on ChatGPT plans through OpenAI for Nonprofits
- Adobe Acrobat Pro for Nonprofits
- Nonprofit profile to receive funding from Goodstack corporate partners
howToGetIt:
1. Visit goodstack.org and sign up (free)
2. Verify your nonprofit status (501c3 or equivalent)
3. Create an organizational account
4. Browse available software discounts
5. Claim discounts directly through the platform
keywords: Goodstack, Percent, nonprofit software, Zoom discount, Adobe Acrobat, Asana, OpenAI, ChatGPT, Docusign, SaaS, 501c3, grants
